name: redis-bridge
description: A Redis primary and replica in their own network namespaces; every acknowledged SET survives on the primary and reaches the replica.

text./etc/redis-primary.conf:
port 6379
bind 0.0.0.0
protected-mode no
dir /data/primary
save ""
appendonly yes
appendfsync always
repl-diskless-sync-delay 0
hz 1
dynamic-hz no
text./etc/redis-replica.conf:
port 6379
bind 0.0.0.0
protected-mode no
dir /data/replica
save ""
replicaof primary 6379
repl-diskless-sync-delay 0
hz 1
dynamic-hz no

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  r=$(timeout 2 /bin/redis-cli -h redisp -p 6380 SET k:$i v$i 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$r" = OK ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  else echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
  sleep 0.5
  echo "redis-bridge: step $i ${r:-no answer}, replica lag $(lag)" > /dev/console
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: every SET the client saw acknowledged reads back from the primary
invariants.cmd:
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  [ "$(/bin/redis-cli -h primary GET k:$i)" = "v$i" ] || { echo "key k:$i lost on the primary"; exit 1; }
done
echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) all on the primary"

invariants.msg: every acknowledged SET reaches the replica within 30 s after the faults end
invariants.cmd:
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  [ "$(/bin/redis-cli -h replica GET k:$i)" = "v$i" ] || { echo "k:$i not on the replica yet (lag $(lag))"; exit 1; }
done
echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) all on the replica"
